G2973.name: Cosam
G2973.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
G2973.brief: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
G2973.short: Cosam is listed as an ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy.

G2913.name: Crescens
G2913.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2913.brief: Companion of Paul who went to Galatia
G2913.short: Crescens, a companion of Paul, went to Galatia during Paul's imprisonment.

G2921.name: Crispus
G2921.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2921.brief: Synagogue leader in Corinth who believed in Jesus
G2921.short: Crispus, the synagogue leader in Corinth, believed in Jesus and was baptized by Paul.

G2976H.name: Lazarus
G2976H.desc: Mary's brother living at the time of the New Testament
G2976H.brief: Brother of Mary and Martha; raised from the dead
G2976H.short: Lazarus, the brother of Mary and Martha, was raised from the dead by Jesus (<ref="Jhn.11.1-44; 12.1-2,9-11">Jhn.11.1-44; 12.1-2,9-11</ref>).

G2976G.name: Lazarus
G2976G.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2976G.brief: Poor man in Jesus' parable of the rich man
G2976G.short: Lazarus, a poor man in Jesus' parable of the rich man and Lazarus (<ref="Luk.16.20-25">Luk.16.20-25</ref>).

G2958.name: Quirinius
G2958.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2958.brief: Governor of Syria during a census mentioned in Luke
G2958.short: Quirinius was the governor of Syria when a census was taken, as mentioned in Luke's Gospel.

G2972.name: Cos
G2972.brief: Island visited by Paul on his journey
G2972.short: Cos was an island in the Aegean Sea where Paul's ship stopped during his return journey to Jerusalem.

G2956.name: Cyrene
G2956.brief: City in North Africa; home of early Christians
G2956.short: Cyrene, a city in North Africa, was the hometown of Simon, who carried Jesus' cross, and several early Christians mentioned in Acts.

G2993.name: Laodicea
G2993.short: Laodicea, a city in Asia Minor, known for its lukewarm faith (<ref="Revelation 3:14-16">Revelation 3:14-16</ref>).
G2993.meaning: named for Laodice; the name means “justice of the people”

G2996.name: Lasea
G2996.brief: A city near Fair Havens, Crete
G2996.short: Lasea, a city near Fair Havens on the island of Crete (<ref="Act.27.8">Act.27.8</ref>).
